subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage ledger as the permanent fork-accounting architecture, or prefer the narrower identity and cache-dependency repair in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: Both paths address the canonical overcount problem but have materially different implementation size, rollout policy, proof requirements, and long-term maintenance cost; code review alone cannot choose the permanent product architecture.

options.title: Review the full stack after proof
options.body: Keep legacy authoritative, review https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order, and decide on lineage only after exact-head corpus evidence is available.

options.title: Prefer the narrower repair
options.body: Land the smaller identity and cache-dependency correction and defer the lineage architecture unless remaining real-corpus failures demonstrate that it is necessary.

options.title: Limit lineage to shadow analysis
options.body: Adopt only non-authoritative diagnostics and family analysis while withholding the promotion and authority-switching surface.

recommendation.title: Review the full stack after proof
recommendation.body: Keep legacy authoritative, review https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order, and decide on lineage only after exact-head corpus evidence is available.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the best available owner for choosing the permanent accounting and rollout direction.
